# Decision: <the call, in one line>

**Date:** YYYY-MM-DD
**Status:** decided | superseded by <file> | reversed
**Owner:** <who made the call>

## What we decided
One or two sentences. The decision, not the discussion.

## Why
The reason that would still hold if you'd forgotten the meeting. Include the number, quote, or constraint that actually moved it.

## What we considered instead
- **<option>** — why it lost.

## What would change this
The signal that should make us revisit. Be specific enough to notice it: *"if enterprise deals stall on this twice more"*, not *"if things change"*.
